items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: That's where I first heard Steve and Manuel Moneta and Pete Marvin. They was on a party there one night.

ctx.x: Yeah. Which corner was that where Pete Lawless used to be on the lake uptown?

No, that was on the river uptown corner. They had strictly piano playing over there. That would go on day and night. That's where I first heard Steve and Manuel Moneta and Pete Marvin. They was on a party there one night. I was nothing but a kid that stole off and put on long pants to go around. And my brother taking me into the Hummin' Boy. And that's where Steve was playing. And later on my uncle Willie came in. He wasn't expecting to see me there, but since I was there, we made a jam section out of it. And he…
Where was that? Is that near where Odois is?
